t=$(mktemp -d) && mkdir -p "$t/dest"
for s in 20260101-000000 20260102-000000 20260103-000000; do printf 'd\n' > "$t/dest/app-$s.tar.gz"; done
echo "--- rotate --dry-run --keep=2 (old-style =form flag)"
bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest="$t/dest" --name=app --keep=2 --dry-run
echo "--- rotate -n --keep 1"
bash rotate.sh -q --dest "$t/dest" --name app -n --keep 1
echo "--- rotate --keep 0 must be rejected (exit 1)"
bash rotate.sh -q --dest "$t/dest" --name app --keep 0; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- rotate unknown option (exit 1)"
bash rotate.sh -q --dest "$t/dest" --name app --bogus; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- rotate missing dest (exit 2)"
bash rotate.sh -q --dest "$t/nodir" --name app --keep 1; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- rotate --help (exit 0, first line)"
bash rotate.sh --help | head -1
echo "--- verify --name prefix filter, spaces, missing dest exit 2"
printf 'x y\n' > "$t/dest/rel notes-20260101-000000.tar.gz"
(cd "$t/dest" && shasum -a 256 "rel notes-20260101-000000.tar.gz" > "rel notes-20260101-000000.tar.gz.sha256")
bash verify.sh -q --dest "$t/dest" --name rel; echo "rc=$?"
bash verify.sh -q --dest "$t/dest" --name app; echo "rc=$? (no app sidecars)"
bash verify.sh --dest="$t/nodir"; echo "rc=$?"
bash verify.sh --help | head -1
rm -rf "$t"
